purpose: 1:1 physical fit coupon; fabrication and populated fit results are required before orderable status
orientation_scope: SW_L 0-degree and SW_R 180-degree conservatively exercise both representative bottom-socket orientations required by CON-ARCH-004 AC-9

low_current_vf.connect: external current source between each ANODE and ROW probe
low_current_vf.record: forward voltage and polarity for all three populated ES1B samples

row_high_3v0_3v3.connect: external tester drives COL, closes the matching switch, and senses ROW
row_high_3v0_3v3.record: ROW high voltage and noise margin for press and release

zero_wait_scan.connect: external zero-wait matrix harness uses the labeled COL and ROW probes
zero_wait_scan.record: missing, false, or stuck events during representative three-key stress

coverage_limitations.non_1u: not_covered_by_this_three-switch_coupon; use revised coupon or first article
coverage_limitations.housing_clearance: requires printed housing or first-article fit
coverage_limitations.scan_stress: representative_three_sample_only; maximum same-row/same-column matrix stress requires first article
